title: Stationfall: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Stationfall failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If station runs collapse, lower your objective count. Add oxygen and repair margin, mark exits, and leave earlier than instinct says.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If station runs collapse, lower objective count, leave earlier, carry more oxygen, mark exits, and treat pressure repair as route survival rather than cleanup.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
